steps.name: Set up job
system packages
Run actions/checkout@v4
publication failure tests (offline, no signing secret)
Rust 1.96.0
artifact provenance regression (offline, disposable Cargo workspace)
restore the cache
unchanged source files get the cached build's times back
record fresh source times for a cold publication build
Run taiki-e/install-action@v2
build (release, the lamps' binaries)
every built lamp-* binary is classified for the lamp-os package
build the two selected artifact examples without filename collisions
publication CLI rehearsal (local test key and simulated GitHub only)
which crates a pull request tests
test (full run, every test one at a time; otherwise without the realtime group, in parallel)
doc tests and the own-harness tests (nextest runs neither)
export only current Cargo targets and their SHA-256
Run actions/upload-artifact@v4
discard the isolated example target before saving the cache
save the cache
Post Run actions/checkout@v4
Complete job
